senses.gloss:
शैनेय शैनेय, अस्, m. (fr. शिनि), N. of Sāt-
yaki, the charioteer of Kṛṣṇa (represented as having
destroyed a number of Dasyus, Mahā-bh. Droṇa-p.
4748); (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of Śini (a
branch of the Yādavas).

शैन्य, आस्, m. pl. the descendants of Śini (who be-
came Brāhmans, though originally of Kṣattriya race).

सैन्य, अस्, m. a soldier, one under arms, one
drawn up in martial array; a guard, sentinel; (अम्),
n. an army.
—सैन्य-पृष्ठ, अम्, n. the rear of
an army.
—सैन्याधिपति (˚य-अध्˚), इस्, or सै-
न्याध्यक्ष (˚य-अध्˚), अस्, m. ‘army-overseer,’
a general, commander.

सैनापत्य, अम्, n. (fr. सेना-पति), the office of
a general, command of an army, generalship.

सैंह सैंह, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. सिंह), belonging
to lions, leonine, lion-like.

सैंहिक, अस्, ई, अम्, lion-like, leonine; (अस्), m.,
N. of Rāhu or the personified ascending node (=
सैंहिकेय below).

सैंहिकेय, अस्, m. (fr. सिंहिका, q. v.), a metro-
nymic of Rāhu, q. v.; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a class of
Dānavas.

सैन्धव सैन्धव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. सिन्धु), pro-
duced or born in Sindh or in the country near the
Indus; belonging to the Indus; river-born; belong-
ing to the sea, oceanic, marine, aquatic; (अस्), m. a
horse (particular one bred in Sindh); N. of a Muni;
of a family; of a country; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a kind
of rock-salt (found in the country near the Indus);
(ई), f., N. of one of the Rāgiṇīs or personified
musical scales; (अम्), n. (in dramatic literature) a
kind of song in Prākṛt words accompanied with
music expressive of disappointment in the keeping
of an assignation; (आस्), m. pl. the people inhabit-
ing Sindh or the country near the Indus.
—सैन्-
धव-घन, अस्, m. a lump of salt.
—सैन्धव-
शिला, f. ‘Sindh-rock,’ a kind of rock or fossil-salt.
—सैन्धवारण्य (˚व-अर्˚), अस्, अम्, m. n. the
jungly district of Sindhu or the Indus.

सैन्धवक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating
to the Saindhavas; (अस्), m. a miserable inhabitant
of Sindhu.

सैन्धवायन, अस्, m., N. of a teacher of the
Atharva-veda; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a family (supposed
to have been descended from Viśvā-mitra).

सैन्धी सैन्धी, f. (according to Śabda-k.)
spirituous liquor (especially that prepared from the
fermented juice of the palm).
